purpose: Side and front view of 4-wheel rover with front bucket drum feeding rear hopper
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,5)
# chassis
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,2.2),5,0.8,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(4.5,2.6,'chassis',fontsize=8)
# hopper
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.5,3.0),2,0.8,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(5.0,3.3,'hopper',fontsize=8)
# wheels
for x in [2.5,6.5]:
    c=plt.Circle((x,1.5),0.8,fill=False,lw=2)
    ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.text(x-0.3,1.4,f'wheel D300',fontsize=7)
    # grousers
    for a in [0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315]:
        import math
        r1=0.8; r2=0.95
        x1=x+r1*math.cos(math.radians(a)); y1=1.5+r1*math.sin(math.radians(a))
        x2=x+r2*math.cos(math.radians(a)); y2=1.5+r2*math.sin(math.radians(a))
        ax.plot([x1,x2],[y1,y2],lw=2)
ax.text(2.5,0.4,'moving wheel',fontsize=8); ax.text(6.0,0.4,'ground BP-1 bed',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([0.5,9.5],[0.6,0.6],lw=2)
# bucket drum front
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((1.5,1.8),0.5,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0.3,2.5,'rotating bucket drum',fontsize=8)
ax.arrow(1.5,1.8,0.4,0.3,lw=1.5,head_width=0.1)
ax.arrow(2.0,2.0,2.5,0.8,lw=1.2,head_width=0.1)
ax.text(2.8,2.9,'soil flow to hopper',fontsize=7)
ax.text(5,0.05,'SIDE VIEW: fixed chassis, moving wheels + drum over fixed soil',fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
